ex-102-1.title: Can the water mix?
ex-102-1.question: Ivy places two glass columns of hot and cold water as shown. She thinks that when the plastic sheet between the two columns is removed, hot and cold water will mix immediately due to convection. However, actually the water does not mix well completely until the water reaches thermal equilibrium after a period of time. Explain why.
ex-102-1.answer: Since the hot water is already at the top, it cannot rise even when the plastic sheet is removed. Similarly, the cold water at the bottom cannot sink. As a result, no convection current can be formed.
ex-102-1.think: What will happen if an air conditioner is installed at a low position in a room?
ex-102-1.thinkAnswer: The cooled air is denser and tends to remain near the floor. Natural convection circulates the air less effectively, so the upper part of the room remains relatively warm and the room cools less uniformly. A fan can provide forced circulation, but a high position assists natural convection.
